description: This file defines the MarketplaceAgreementClient class in the Aws\MarketplaceAgreement namespace, which extends the AwsClient class to interact with the AWS Marketplace Agreement Service. It provides methods to describe agreements, get agreement terms, and search agreements, including their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: MarketplaceAgreementClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Agreement Service, providing methods to manage and retrieve marketplace agreements.

methods.name: describeAgreement
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific marketplace agreement.

methods.name: describeAgreementAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves details of a specific marketplace agreement.

methods.name: getAgreementTerms
methods.description: Retrieves the terms of a specified marketplace agreement.

methods.name: getAgreementTermsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the terms of a specified marketplace agreement.

methods.name: searchAgreements
methods.description: Searches for marketplace agreements based on provided criteria.

methods.name: searchAgreementsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously searches for marketplace agreements based on criteria.
